programme.title: 'Alo 'Alo
programme.desc: Drugi svjetski rat bjesni, ali u francuskom selu Nouvion, vlasnik kafea Rene Artois želi voditi miran život, ali i očijukati sa konobaricom Ivette iza leđa svoje mrzovoljne supruge Edith. 'Allo 'Allo! je kultna britanska BBC - jeva humoristička serija, koja se prikazivala od 1982. do 1992, u 9 sezona tj. 85 epizoda. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Uprkos opštem mišljenju, svrha serije nije bila ismijavanje Drugog svjetskog rata nego karikiranje ratnih filmova i televizijskih drama, posebno drame BBC - a "Tajna vojska" koja se bavila događajima članova Pokreta otpora utvrđenih u kafeu u Bruxellesu. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svjetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nijemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vrijedna umjetnička djela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku "Posrnula Bogorodica". Komandir grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa ju daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je pronađe. U isto vrijeme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran da radi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što poslužuje Nijemce. René se takođe trudi balansirati između afera s konobaricama Yvette, Mariom i Mimi i braka s Edith.

programme.title: Povuci ručnu
programme.desc: Humoristični TV serijal "Povuci ručnu" sadrži 72 polučasovne epizode u kojima je naš poznati glumac Jovan Radovanović - autor, zabavljač, muzički urednik i producent. Emisija je kolažnog tipa i traje oko trideset pet minuta. Pored domaćina Jove Radovanovića učestvuje i stalna ekipa glumaca Mina Lazarević i Božidar Bole Stošić, kao i po jedan gost. Zastupljena je zabavna muzika uz jednu priču iz života, dva skeča, dvojnika, rubriku vesti, kuvara kao šou numeru, najavu i odjavu s gostom, njihovu solo muzičku numeru, kao i duet.

Lansirala je i mnogobrojne likove i karaktere... BB Show je najdugotrajnija humoristička tv serija na prostorima bivše Jugoslavije. Koncipirana je kao red skeč viceva, red duhovitih muzičkih spotova. Lansirala je i mnogobrojne likove i karaktere koji su zasmejavali decu i odrasle godinama. Snimljeno je 7000 viceva, bez političkih i seksualnih konotacija.

programme.desc: Emisija za sve ljubitelje stendap komedije! Uživajte uz britak i direktan humor najboljih stendap komičara sa naših prostora! programme.title: Pogled odozdo
programme.desc: Urnebesan stand up šou, sa nastupima uživo, prošaranim zabavnim skečevima. Šou se na duhovit način osvrće na razne pojave u društvu. Van engleskog govornog područja, gde je i nastala, ova vrsta scenskog nastupa postaje sve omiljenija među publikom, a odlična ekipa na čelu sa Srdjanom Jovanovićem, aktuelne probleme, vrcavim i domišljatim humorom, učiniće mnogo bezazlenijim. Pogled Odozdo, relaksira, prosvećuje i zabavlja!

programme.title: Leteći Cirkus Monti Pajtona
programme.desc: Početak emitovanja ove serije 5. oktobra 1969. godine označio je početak nove ere komedije, kako u ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu, tako i širem svetu, jer su "montipajtonovci, nadmašivači", u četiri sezone. u početku razumljiv malom broju gledalaca, da bi kasnije stekli veliku popularnost širom sveta. Serija se izdvaja upotrebom apsurdnih situacija, pomešanih sa rizičnim i nagoveštajima-zasutim humorom, vizuelnim gegovima i opservacionim skečevima bez poente vica.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Rene Artoa (Gorden Kej) je vlasnik kafea u okupiranom francuskom gradiću Nuvionu u vreme Drugog svetskog rata. On se nalazi između dve vatre: naizgled sarađuje sa nacistima a u stvari potajno pomaže Pokretu otpora.Nemački pukovnik Von Strom (Ričard Marner) je u dobrim odnosima sa Reneom ali koristi kafe da sakrije ukradenu sliku, koju planira da proda posle rata. Nažalost Hitler takođe želi sliku i poslao je gestapovca Oto Flika (Ričard Gibson) da je pronađe. A sa druge strane Pokret otpora, koji predvodi Mišel (Kirsten Kuk) kod Renea krije britanske vazduhoplovce. U sred sve te zbrke Rene mora i da skriva afere sa konobaricama od svoje žene Edit (Karmen Silvera).

programme.desc: Početak emitovanja ove serije 5. oktobra 1969. godine označio je početak nove ere komedije, kako u ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu, tako i širem svetu, jer su "montipajtonovci, nadmašivači", u četiri sezone. u početku razumljiv malom broju gledalaca, da bi kasnije stekli veliku popularnost širom sveta. Serija se izdvaja upotrebom apsurdnih situacija, pomešanih sa rizičnim i nagoveštajima-zasutim humorom, vizuelnim gegovima i opservacionim skečevima bez poente vica.

programme.title: 'Alo 'Alo
programme.desc: Drugi svjetski rat bjesni, ali u francuskom selu Nouvion, vlasnik kafea Rene Artois želi voditi miran život, ali i očijukati sa konobaricom Ivette iza leđa svoje mrzovoljne supruge Edith. 'Allo 'Allo! je kultna britanska BBC - jeva humoristička serija, koja se prikazivala od 1982. do 1992, u 9 sezona tj. 85 epizoda. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Uprkos opštem mišljenju, svrha serije nije bila ismijavanje Drugog svjetskog rata nego karikiranje ratnih filmova i televizijskih drama, posebno drame BBC - a "Tajna vojska" koja se bavila događajima članova Pokreta otpora utvrđenih u kafeu u Bruxellesu. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svjetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nijemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vrijedna umjetnička djela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku "Posrnula Bogorodica". Komandir grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa ju daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je pronađe. U isto vrijeme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran da radi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što poslužuje Nijemce. René se takođe trudi balansirati između afera s konobaricama Yvette, Mariom i Mimi i braka s Edith.

programme.title: O 5 minút 12
programme.desc: Politická diskusia o témach, ktoré počas týždňa rezonovali v politickom a spoločenskom dianí. Slovenská republika (2026).

programme.title: Občan za dverami
programme.desc: Dnešný svet je rýchly a uponáhľaný. Na chyby neexistuje priestor. Zákony či predpisy totiž zľutovanie nemajú. Presvedčil sa o tom aj pán Jozef. Pri kúpe diaľničnej známky si v evidenčnom čísle pomýlil jedno písmeno. Prišiel na to až po takmer dvoch rokoch, keď celkový sumár pokút narástol na 1800 eur... Kúpil budovu v areáli bývalého družstva. Pôvodná príjazdová cesta sa však medzičasom stala minulosťou. Skratku nahradila dlhšia cesta cez celý areál, no čo je horšie - po cudzích pozemkoch.

programme.title: Agatha Christie : Poirot IX.
programme.desc: V Čínskom mestečku sa nájde mŕtvy obchodník, ktorý vlastnil mapu k dlho zabudnutej bani na ťažbu striebra. Poirot musí nájsť mapu aj zabijaka. (skryté titulky).

programme.title: Červené víno
programme.desc: Druhá časť 3-dielneho televízneho filmu, adaptácie románu F.Hečka. Najstarší syn Urban po úteku z domu žije vo Vlčindole, hrozí mu dražba a jeho poctivá práca vychádza na zmar. Skutočnou pohromou je však I. svetová vojna, ktorá postihne nielen Habdžovcov, ale celý Vlčindol. Niektorí umierajú na fronte, ďalších postihne choroba, jediné čo pretrváva sú ľudská láska a nenávisť. (skryté titulky).

programme.title: Cestou necestou
programme.desc: Cali, oficiálne Santiago de Cali, je hlavné mesto departementu Valle del Cauca na juhozápade Kolumbie. Leží v údolí rieky Cauca medzi horskými pásmami Ánd, približne 1000 metrov nad morom. Je tretím najväčším mestom krajiny po Bogote a Medellíne a patrí k najvýznamnejším centrám juhozápadnej Kolumbie. Hoci bolo Cali založené už v roku 1536, nie je typickým koloniálnym mestom plným veľkolepých historických pamiatok.

programme.title: Zvuky domova
programme.desc: Keď Bystrík upravoval pieseň Sedemdesiat sukien mala do modernej podoby, ešte netušil, čo všetko tým spôsobí. Vďaka Jakubovi sa začne pátranie po tom, či existovalo dievča, ktoré si oblieklo sedemdesiat sukien naraz. Stopy vedú do Šenkvíc a našim dvom pátračom sa pritom podarí objaviť folklórny súbor Mladosť. Podarí sa napokon Jakubovi s Bystríkom odhaliť záhadu sedemdesiatich sukien? (skryté titulky).

programme.desc: Šiesta séria obľúbenej talentovej šou, v ktorej budete svedkami výnimočného pečenia. Na 12 finalistov čakajú 3 výzvy, v ktorých zabojujú pred celým Slovenskom o titul Majstra alebo Majsterky pekárky. Slovenská republika (2026). Prichádza nová, už šiesta séria obľúbenej šou Pečie celé Slovensko! Najväčšie výzvy častokrát čakajú na začiatku vytýčeného cieľa . Finalisti si zaspomínajú na svoje pekárske začiatky, téma prvého dielu totiž nesie názov "moje prvé". Ich pokroky preveria obľúbené porotkyne Jožka Zaukolcová a Petra Tóthová. Začína náročná cesta, na ktorej konci spoznáme nového Majstra alebo Majsterku pekárku. Prevedú nás po nej skúsení moderátori a ochutnávači Juraj Bača a Milan Zimnýkoval.

Primárom oddelenia je doktor Cesare Corvara, ktorý vytvára tím schopný vykonať transplantáciu srdca. Seriál zachytáva profesionálne úspechy aj osobné vzťahy lekárov v období, keď sa medicína dynamicky mení a zavádzajú sa prelomové operácie a postupy.

programme.title: Horúci dych
programme.desc: Televizní film podle novely Jána Kozáka "Marianna Radvaková". Mariana je nešťastne vydatá žena, pre ktorú jej manžel Michal nemá pekného slova. Aby toho nebolo málo, žije v spoločnom dome so svokrovcami, ktorí ju za nevestu nikdy nechceli. Michal sa rozhodne stavať dom, na ktorom bude musieť tvrdo pracovať i Mariana. Viac driny a odriekania znamená v ich manželskom živote ešte väčšie prázdno. Lásku i pomocnú ruku k Mariane v tichosti naťahuje Turok. V dedine však takéto tajomstvá dlho nevydržia.

programme.title: Práče
programme.desc: Na podzim roku 1944 je k frontové prádelně přidělen malý nalezenec z osvobozeného koncentračního tábora. Vojáci si Františka oblíbí a přezdívají mu Práče. Válka Františka ovlivnila na tolik, že se touží zúčastnit bojových akcí a dokázat dospělým kamarádům svou statečnost. Na podzim roku 1944 osvobodí sovětští vojáci jeden z koncentračních táborů. Devítiletého českého sirotka Františka Bureše předají k československé vojenské jednotce, která táboří na polské straně před Dukelským průsmykem, kde se schyluje k jedné z nejkrvavějších operací celé války. Chlapec se ocitne u polní frontové prádelny, kde zažívá veselé i smutné příhody. Vojáci si nebojácného Františka rázem zamilují a dají mu přezdívku Práče - podle husitských dětských vojáků, kteří útočili na... nepřátele praky. Avšak Práčeti se u prádelny nelíbí. Místo nošení mýdla a počítání prádla raději doručuje důležité zprávy přímo na frontu a učí se střílet z opravdové pušky. Chlapec si neuvědomuje, co válka skutečně znamená. A prožívá ji jako jedno velké dobrodružství.

programme.title: Detektívi zo severu XI
programme.desc: V ďalších častiach obľúbenej kriminálnej série Morden im Norden sa vracia sympatický tím vyšetrovateľov z Lübecku, ktorí riešia nové záhadné prípady plné napätia, nečakaných zvratov a ľudských príbehov. Každé vyšetrovanie odhaľuje nielen stopy k páchateľom, ale aj zložité vzťahy, tajomstvá a osudy ľudí stojacich v centre prípadu. Seriál ponúka ideálnu kombináciu klasickej detektívky, jemného humoru a príjemnej atmosféry severného Nemecka.

programme.title: Profesionáli IV
programme.desc: Bodie a Doyle, členovia špeciálnej jednotky CI5 bojujú proti kriminalite svojským spôsobom. Doyle ako bývalý detektív, sa cíti v podsvetí ako ryba vo vode. Pozná množstvo informátorov a gangstrov.Bodie je pre zmenu bývalým žoldnierom a výsadkárom SAS. V porovnaní s Doylom je tvrdším, drsnejším a temnejším členom tímu. Obom šéfuje major George Cowley, veterán 2.svetovej vojny. (skryté titulky).

Kapik nachádza prepojenia profesora Brenka na ŠTB. Rovnako zo spolupráce s komunistickou tajnou službou sú obviňované aj iné postavy, s ktorými sa v seriáli stretávame. programme.title: Reportéri
programme.desc: KEĎ ZABÍJA DIEŤA: Miesto, kde by mali byť deti v bezpečí, sa opäť stalo dejiskom tragédie. Na základnej škole v Staškove útočil nožom len 13-ročný žiak. Pokojný začiatok vyučovania sa zmenil na boj o život. Náš štáb zisťoval priamo na mieste, ako k incidentu došlo a čo mu predchádzalo. Prípad z Kysúc opäť otvára vážne otázky. Kde sa berie agresia u mladistvých? Aká má byť ich trestná zodpovednosť a ako podobným útokom na školách zabrániť.

programme.title: Sunville – Sportsville
programme.desc: All of your favourite Sunville residents join together to participate in one amazing sports day. Mister Goat, the Raccoon Family, Kitty Cat and the Friendly Pig are participating in Sports Day, and they want you to come along and join the fun! This interactive cartoon encourages children to join in and exercise alongside these incredibly cute characters, who can at times be a little competitive, too. In doing so, not only will your child have lots of fun, but they will be exercising and developing basic coordination skills along the way. They will also increase muscle strength and sense of balance, which will benefit them in their everyday lives, and keep them healthy and happy.

programme.title: Risto Gusto
programme.desc: Let's have a look on Basil's, Yam's and Oregano's restaurant and peek out what goodies are made in the kitchen of Risto Gusto. There will be no question of what is healthy and what is unhealthy, because our favorites always offer the best for us.

programme.title: Didy Baby
programme.desc: Didy Baby is a collection of fun and touching stories all about a group of adorable baby animals. The main theme of this heartwarming yet educational show is the idea of helping each other and working together. It aims to improve its young viewers social skills, develop their observational and thinking skills whilst introducing them to the concept of problem solving and decision making. The show consists of lots of simple situations and stories that encourage creative thinking and widen children's awareness. As an added bonus, problem solving and story telling with your child will help to tighten your relationship.

programme.title: Enchanting Sights
programme.desc: This children's animation displays spinning and spiralling geometric shapes, and is accompanied by the calming sound of soothing music, ideal for a young child. This programme can aid children in learning the names of shapes, giving them a head start in their mathematical development, and spacial awareness. The combination of colour, music, and shapes also aims to nurture the child's ability to be creative and imaginative. This is a programme designed to keep children entertained, but also aid their development, and educate them to a degree, as well.

programme.title: Doll Team to the Rescue
programme.desc: Join Bell and her friends Fido the Kangaroo and Lilo the Bear as they come to help everyone and anyone in the forest! Incorporating education into enjoyable animations, cartoons and mini-series', Doll Team to the Rescue educates toddlers and children in developing their social skills with others, the importance of friendship, all whilst being able to experience various adventures! The main message within Doll Team to the Rescue is to teach children the love and respect for animals. Ducktv recommend that parents, in order to teach the importance of taking care of people as well as respecting animals, should take them to an animal shelter and explain the necessity of protecting and rescuing animals. Ducktv which specialises in television for absolute beginners create animations, cartoons and miniseries bring fun alongside entertainment for the smallest TV viewers. Under supervision of child psychologists in order to meet all requirements for babies after 3 months, the characteristics of each episode of their shows with music help children to develop their cognitive capabilities. Available 24 hours and 7 days a week, Ducktv ensures to amuse, develop and relax younger audiences as well as educating them in an enjoyable way.

programme.title: In the Museum
programme.desc: Can you help Mr.Clown find the missing animals? When animals start mysteriously disappearing from some of the paintings in the museum, Mr.Clown must go searching for them so that he can put them back in their correct places. In the Museum is a great introduction to different kinds of art for the littlest viewers, promotes shape recognition and helps young viewers to recognise and identify different types of animals. Importantly you can also use the animals disappearing as a great way to let young viewers know that it is perfectly okay to make mistakes.

programme.title: Color Clara
programme.desc: Clara is an extraordinary, extra colourful, chameleon girl. Deep in the jungle in her cosy chameleon house, Clara uses her colour changing powers for good by helping her wrongly coloured jungles friends and objects to return to their natural colour. Making learning fun again, this exciting jungle tale helps young viewers to connect objects to their usual colours, developing their basic visual skills and introducing them to new and exotic environments such as the jungle.

programme.title: Puffy and Tubby
programme.desc: Puffy and Tubby are a couple of adorable little guinea pigs and they are always hungry. Join them as they go on everyday adventures, exploring their environment in an attempt to find more food. Helping young viewers to develop their social skills, experience various different adventures and identify new everyday objects, this show is the perfect combination of education and fun. Make the lessons even more interactive for your little ones by associating the objects identified in the show with those in your home.

programme.title: Groups
programme.desc: Learning to categorise objects is so much easier with the help of the friendly baby fox in Groups. This show is most beneficial with sufficient interaction with the children that it's aimed at, for example the learning of older children is enhanced by asking them questions such as "what's different" between two or more objects. For younger children it is more beneficial to just point out these differences or similarities. Groups helps to develop young viewers' observational skills, attributing objects into different categories and recognising defining attributes of different objects.

programme.title: My Pet Family
programme.desc: Pets are part of the family! In My Pet Family, the preschooler Tony shows us how much joy, love and responsibility comes with owning pets. Molly, the cat and Lucas, the puppy give Tony all their love while they learn, play, eat, bath and share adventures together.Stories are backed by psychological research on how owning a pet is beneficial for children. While enjoying My Pet Family your children will receive support in understanding responsibilities and that animals are to be respected, protected and loved.

programme.title: DuckSchool
programme.desc: In a forest kindergarden, woodland animals who call it their home are learning the basics of English from their helpful fairy teacher, Miss Sunshine. programme.title: Groups
programme.desc: Learning to categorise objects is so much easier with the help of the friendly baby fox in Groups. For younger children it is more beneficial to just point out these differences or similarities. Groups helps to develop young viewers' observational skills, attributing objects into different categories and recognising defining attributes of different objects.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home

programme.title: Get Up!

programme.desc: Animated children's series following Cubie the builder who has fantastic plans for new buildings. programme.title: Didy Baby
programme.desc: Didy Baby is a collection of fun and touching stories all about a group of adorable baby animals. The main theme of this heartwarming yet educational show is the idea of helping each other and working together. It aims to improve its young viewers social skills, develop their observational and thinking skills whilst introducing them to the concept of problem solving and decision making. The show consists of lots of simple situations and stories that encourage creative thinking and widen children's awareness. As an added bonus, problem solving and story telling with your child will help to tighten your relationship.

programme.title: Henry's Stories
programme.desc: Henry loves telling stories, but he needs your help to make sure it's all in the correct order. Follow Henry in these silent animated shorts as he constructs stories with the help of his handy picture cards. Narrate the sequences together and solve his picture puzzles to see the story come to life. Identify the beginnings and endings of simple everyday stories, while carefully piecing together all of the events in between. Teaches children about cause and effect, while encouraging logical thinking and deductive reasoning.

programme.desc: Join Bell and her friends Fido the Kangaroo and Lilo the Bear as they come to help everyone and anyone in the forest! Incorporating education into enjoyable animations, cartoons and mini-series', Doll Team to the Rescue educates toddlers and children in developing their social skills with others, the importance of friendship, all whilst being able to experience various adventures! The main message within Doll Team to the Rescue is to teach children the love and respect for animals. Ducktv recommend that parents, in order to teach the importance of taking care of people as well as respecting animals, should take them to an animal shelter and explain the necessity of protecting and rescuing animals. Ducktv which specialises in television for absolute beginners create animations, cartoons and miniseries bring fun alongside entertainment for the smallest TV viewers. programme.title: Lola and the Numbers
programme.desc: Lola is a playful little girls who loves numbers! She is constantly on the move and is always ready to count together with her number firends from one to ten. Lola and the Numbers is all about setting that pre-math knowledge for its young viewers. The show helps us to identify different numbers, count from one to ten and develop our pre-math skills. The most important viewing tip is that we always count with Lola! whether in English or your own language, counting along is always fun.

programme.title: In the Museum
programme.desc: Can you help Mr.Clown find the missing animals? When animals start mysteriously disappearing from some of the paintings in the museum, Mr.Clown must go searching for them so that he can put them back in their correct places. In the Museum is a great introduction to different kinds of art for the littlest viewers, promotes shape recognition and helps young viewers to recognise and identify different types of animals. Importantly you can also use the animals disappearing as a great way to let young viewers know that it is perfectly okay to make mistakes.

programme.title: Little Melodies
programme.desc: All your favourite characters will help your young children learn lots of beautiful English nursery songs, in a way that makes music fun! This encourages creativity, as you learn lots of fun new songs. This skill can be extended to everyday life; sing these songs at bedtime, in the car, on a walk, whenever! This sharpens the sense of hearing and nurtures any musical skills, aiding child development. This is a Duck TV production. Duck TV aim to produce content that is both educational and entertaining.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: This cartoon takes a look into the lives of a range of the cutest baby animals, and explores their family relationships. Everyday, after a big adventure exploring their surroundings, they'll return home to their loving families, to be greeted with lots of love and affection. As is the case with many Duck TV programmes, this programme is designed to both educate and entertain it's young audience. Children will become able to recognise the similar characteristic features of animals, develop social skills, and present emotional bonds, as well as thoroughly enjoying their viewing time.

programme.title: My Pet Family
programme.desc: Pets are part of the family! In My Pet Family, the preschooler Tony shows us how much joy, love and responsibility comes with owning pets. While enjoying My Pet Family your children will receive support in understanding responsibilities and that animals are to be respected, protected and loved.

programme.title: Dotty, the Kitty
programme.desc: A super fun and creative show, Dotty the Kitty attempts to connect the dots that the pencil draws to discover the hidden image and paint the final picture. As always with Duck TV this show make education and development exciting and enjoyable for its young viewers. Helping children to connect the dots improves their ability to recognise and identify shapes and objects, develop hand-eye coordination and for the slightly older viewers it improves their association of objects with their realistic shapes and colours. Encouraging the creativity and imagination out of your child, Dotty the Kitty provides endless fun.

programme.title: Groups
programme.desc: Learning to categorise objects is so much easier with the help of the friendly baby fox in Groups. This show is most beneficial with sufficient interaction with the children that it's aimed at, for example the learning of older children is enhanced by asking them questions such as "what's different" between two or more objects. For younger children it is more beneficial to just point out these differences or similarities. Groups helps to develop young viewers' observational skills, attributing objects into different categories and recognising defining attributes of different objects.

programme.title: Ducky Adventures
programme.desc: Every day is a different adventure for Ducky! This animated show for very young children lets toddlers and pre-schoolers to join Ducky and learn through daily activities. This series is brought to you by DuckTV, which works with child psychologists in creating programmes for babies and toddlers. Ducky Adventures has been designed to help your child develop their observational skills whilst also letting them use their imagination and creativity. This cartoon can be used as a conversation starter for the little ones in your life: you can talk to toddlers about their thoughts and opinions on the activities you've seen in the programme or the things that happen in your toddler's life.

programme.title: Zack & Ziggy
programme.desc: This lovely animated children's series explores the basic concepts of size and comparison. It follows the everyday adventures of a little nerdy boy named Zack and his loyal dog best friend, Ziggy. The inseparable pair turn every situation into a chance to learn, including taking a walk, playing sports and getting ready for bed. Join the two sweet friends on their exciting exploration of the world around them.

programme.title: DuckSchool
programme.desc: In a forest kindergarden, woodland animals who call it their home are learning the basics of English from their helpful fairy teacher, Miss Sunshine. With Duckschool we can learn about how the seasons change, different kinds of weather, the amazing planets in our night sky and so many other things! There might even be some special guests to meet along the way.

programme.title: Higher the Better
programme.desc: Join Kiteko, the goofy giraffe and Umi, the playful meerkat in Higher the Better, as they observe the everyday life of toddlers and learn from the children about their everyday activities such as picking apples and painting! When they're not helping pick apples with the children, they are going on field trips and making lots of fun whilst they are playing. While watching, focus the attention of the youngster by speaking with them about what the children are drawing or how fast they can run! Combining education and fun, Higher the Better allows the development of social skills for toddlers, encourages them to observe and think deeper about what they are watching on their screen and initiates communication between parent and child, as well as children and their friends! Created by Ducktv, each animation, cartoon and mini-series is created with supervision of child psychologists to meet all the requirements of babies after three months of age. The combination between education, wholesome, amusing and relaxing elements within their shows aid toddlers to develop their visual and auditory abilities. Available 24 hours a day and 7 days a week, parents can be assured that their children can learn all the skills they need in life whilst still doing something fun.

programme.title: The Way We Travel
programme.desc: This cartoon is designed to aid the development of young children. Your child will watch various vehicles, therefore making them aware of a variety of different shapes and objects in the real world. They will also observe how they operate, which will allow them to grow an understanding of how they may be used in everyday life, as they see their different parts. Additionally, your child will experience the noises that these vehicles make, and be given the opportunity to acquire basic language skills, too. This show will not only keep young children entertained, but it will educate them too, in regards to the outside world.

programme.title: Didy Baby
programme.desc: Didy Baby is a collection of fun and touching stories all about a group of adorable baby animals. The main theme of this heartwarming yet educational show is the idea of helping each other and working together. It aims to improve its young viewers social skills, develop their observational and thinking skills whilst introducing them to the concept of problem solving and decision making. The show consists of lots of simple situations and stories that encourage creative thinking and widen children's awareness. As an added bonus, problem solving and story telling with your child will help to tighten your relationship.

programme.title: Sounds Around Us
programme.desc: Liza and Ben the little elf twins love learning about new sounds. Join them in this series of animated shorts to learn more about sounds, how to find them and how to recreate them. Follow them as they whizz away on exciting adventures together to investigate where different familiar sounds are coming from. Play along with the twins and encourage your child to listen and identify the sounds you hear together. See if you and your child can work out where the sound is coming from before the twins do, while having fun recreating the sounds for yourself at home.

programme.desc: The Ducky family has a brand new member! With the arrival of her little brother Fluffy, Ducky experiences a wide range of new emotions and finds herself in new situations. Stories are created with the support of child psychologists to help children adjust to the arrival of a new sibling.

programme.title: Margo & Felix
programme.desc: Margo and Felix live in a beautiful little house which they must take care of themselves. Although they are responsible for the maintenance of the house they also make lots of time to play games and have fun. Taking on the activities of both adults and children helps to start communication between children and parents about responsibility. Margo and Felix encourages creative thinking and lots of fun.

programme.title: Henry's Stories
programme.desc: Henry loves telling stories, but he needs your help to make sure it's all in the correct order. Follow Henry in these silent animated shorts as he constructs stories with the help of his handy picture cards. Narrate the sequences together and solve his picture puzzles to see the story come to life. Identify the beginnings and endings of simple everyday stories, while carefully piecing together all of the events in between. Teaches children about cause and effect, while encouraging logical thinking and deductive reasoning.

programme.title: Sounds Around Us
programme.desc: Liza and Ben the little elf twins love learning about new sounds. Join them in this series of animated shorts to learn more about sounds, how to find them and how to recreate them. Follow them as they whizz away on exciting adventures together to investigate where different familiar sounds are coming from. Play along with the twins and encourage your child to listen and identify the sounds you hear together. See if you and your child can work out where the sound is coming from before the twins do, while having fun recreating the sounds for yourself at home.

programme.title: Ducky Adventures
programme.desc: Every day is a different adventure for Ducky! This animated show for very young children lets toddlers and pre-schoolers to join Ducky and learn through daily activities. This series is brought to you by DuckTV, which works with child psychologists in creating programmes for babies and toddlers. Ducky Adventures has been designed to help your child develop their observational skills whilst also letting them use their imagination and creativity. This cartoon can be used as a conversation starter for the little ones in your life: you can talk to toddlers about their thoughts and opinions on the activities you've seen in the programme or the things that happen in your toddler's life.

programme.title: Didy Baby
programme.desc: Didy Baby is a collection of fun and touching stories all about a group of adorable baby animals. The main theme of this heartwarming yet educational show is the idea of helping each other and working together. It aims to improve its young viewers social skills, develop their observational and thinking skills whilst introducing them to the concept of problem solving and decision making. The show consists of lots of simple situations and stories that encourage creative thinking and widen children's awareness. As an added bonus, problem solving and story telling with your child will help to tighten your relationship.

programme.title: DuckSchool
programme.desc: In a forest kindergarden, woodland animals who call it their home are learning the basics of English from their helpful fairy teacher, Miss Sunshine. Learn some brand new words and practice your counting skills, or listen carefully to the stories Miss Sunshine has to tell. With Duckschool we can learn about how the seasons change, different kinds of weather, the amazing planets in our night sky and so many other things! There might even be some special guests to meet along the way.

Helping young viewers to develop their social skills, experience various different adventures and identify new everyday objects, this show is the perfect combination of education and fun. programme.title: Color Clara

programme.title: Groups
programme.desc: Learning to categorise objects is so much easier with the help of the friendly baby fox in Groups. Ducktv recommend that parents, in order to teach the importance of taking care of people as well as respecting animals, should take them to an animal shelter and explain the necessity of protecting and rescuing animals. Ducktv which specialises in television for absolute beginners create animations, cartoons and miniseries bring fun alongside entertainment for the smallest TV viewers. Under supervision of child psychologists in order to meet all requirements for babies after 3 months, the characteristics of each episode of their shows with music help children to develop their cognitive capabilities. Available 24 hours and 7 days a week, Ducktv ensures to amuse, develop and relax younger audiences as well as educating them in an enjoyable way.

programme.desc: In Ducky and Friends our little duck is sharing all the fun with her friends, Lola, Henry and Toby. Stories are created with the help of child psychologists and aim to teach toddlers how to play nicely with their friends without arguing and how to adapt during mutual play. They also show that exploring the world with peers brings joy and satisfaction.

programme.title: Didy Baby
programme.desc: Didy Baby is a collection of fun and touching stories all about a group of adorable baby animals. The main theme of this heartwarming yet educational show is the idea of helping each other and working together. It aims to improve its young viewers social skills, develop their observational and thinking skills whilst introducing them to the concept of problem solving and decision making. The show consists of lots of simple situations and stories that encourage creative thinking and widen children's awareness. As an added bonus, problem solving and story telling with your child will help to tighten your relationship.

programme.title: Sounds Around Us
programme.desc: Liza and Ben the little elf twins love learning about new sounds. Join them in this series of animated shorts to learn more about sounds, how to find them and how to recreate them. Follow them as they whizz away on exciting adventures together to investigate where different familiar sounds are coming from. Play along with the twins and encourage your child to listen and identify the sounds you hear together. See if you and your child can work out where the sound is coming from before the twins do, while having fun recreating the sounds for yourself at home.

programme.title: Color Clara
programme.desc: Clara is an extraordinary, extra colourful, chameleon girl. Deep in the jungle in her cosy chameleon house, Clara uses her colour changing powers for good by helping her wrongly coloured jungles friends and objects to return to their natural colour. Making learning fun again, this exciting jungle tale helps young viewers to connect objects to their usual colours, developing their basic visual skills and introducing them to new and exotic environments such as the jungle.

programme.title: DuckSchool
programme.desc: In a forest kindergarden, woodland animals who call it their home are learning the basics of English from their helpful fairy teacher, Miss Sunshine. Learn some brand new words and practice your counting skills, or listen carefully to the stories Miss Sunshine has to tell. With Duckschool we can learn about how the seasons change, different kinds of weather, the amazing planets in our night sky and so many other things! There might even be some special guests to meet along the way.

programme.title: Henry's Stories
programme.desc: Henry loves telling stories, but he needs your help to make sure it's all in the correct order. Follow Henry in these silent animated shorts as he constructs stories with the help of his handy picture cards. Narrate the sequences together and solve his picture puzzles to see the story come to life. Identify the beginnings and endings of simple everyday stories, while carefully piecing together all of the events in between. Teaches children about cause and effect, while encouraging logical thinking and deductive reasoning.

programme.title: Lola and the Numbers
programme.desc: Lola is a playful little girls who loves numbers! She is constantly on the move and is always ready to count together with her number firends from one to ten. Lola and the Numbers is all about setting that pre-math knowledge for its young viewers. The show helps us to identify different numbers, count from one to ten and develop our pre-math skills. The most important viewing tip is that we always count with Lola! whether in English or your own language, counting along is always fun.

programme.title: Zack & Ziggy
programme.desc: This lovely animated children's series explores the basic concepts of size and comparison. It follows the everyday adventures of a little nerdy boy named Zack and his loyal dog best friend, Ziggy. The inseparable pair turn every situation into a chance to learn, including taking a walk, playing sports and getting ready for bed. Join the two sweet friends on their exciting exploration of the world around them.

programme.title: Doll Team to the Rescue
programme.desc: Join Bell and her friends Fido the Kangaroo and Lilo the Bear as they come to help everyone and anyone in the forest! Incorporating education into enjoyable animations, cartoons and mini-series', Doll Team to the Rescue educates toddlers and children in developing their social skills with others, the importance of friendship, all whilst being able to experience various adventures! The main message within Doll Team to the Rescue is to teach children the love and respect for animals. Ducktv recommend that parents, in order to teach the importance of taking care of people as well as respecting animals, should take them to an animal shelter and explain the necessity of protecting and rescuing animals. Ducktv which specialises in television for absolute beginners create animations, cartoons and miniseries bring fun alongside entertainment for the smallest TV viewers. Under supervision of child psychologists in order to meet all requirements for babies after 3 months, the characteristics of each episode of their shows with music help children to develop their cognitive capabilities. Available 24 hours and 7 days a week, Ducktv ensures to amuse, develop and relax younger audiences as well as educating them in an enjoyable way.

programme.title: Ducky Adventures
programme.desc: Every day is a different adventure for Ducky! This animated show for very young children lets toddlers and pre-schoolers to join Ducky and learn through daily activities. This series is brought to you by DuckTV, which works with child psychologists in creating programmes for babies and toddlers. Ducky Adventures has been designed to help your child develop their observational skills whilst also letting them use their imagination and creativity. This cartoon can be used as a conversation starter for the little ones in your life: you can talk to toddlers about their thoughts and opinions on the activities you've seen in the programme or the things that happen in your toddler's life.

programme.title: Tempo Giusto
programme.desc: Tempo Giusto is a playful introduction to the understanding of the concept of time. The always cheerful Lola tells the time and together with the great storyteller Henry, they show us what kids do at different parts of the day.

programme.title: Higher the Better
programme.desc: Join Kiteko, the goofy giraffe and Umi, the playful meerkat in Higher the Better, as they observe the everyday life of toddlers and learn from the children about their everyday activities such as picking apples and painting! When they're not helping pick apples with the children, they are going on field trips and making lots of fun whilst they are playing. While watching, focus the attention of the youngster by speaking with them about what the children are drawing or how fast they can run! Combining education and fun, Higher the Better allows the development of social skills for toddlers, encourages them to observe and think deeper about what they are watching on their screen and initiates communication between parent and child, as well as children and their friends! Created by Ducktv, each animation, cartoon and mini-series is created with supervision of child psychologists to meet all the requirements of babies after three months of age. The combination between education, wholesome, amusing and relaxing elements within their shows aid toddlers to develop their visual and auditory abilities. Available 24 hours a day and 7 days a week, parents can be assured that their children can learn all the skills they need in life whilst still doing something fun.

programme.title: ABC – duckBC
programme.desc: Writing skills introduced, explained and developed through the animated adventures of the five stalwarts of the art of penmanship: Pen, Pencil, Stamp, Eraser and Brush. From A to Z, the five friends take children through the steps to produce beautiful letters and write wonderful words.

programme.title: Sunville – Sportsville
programme.desc: All of your favourite Sunville residents join together to participate in one amazing sports day. Mister Goat, the Raccoon Family, Kitty Cat and the Friendly Pig are participating in Sports Day, and they want you to come along and join the fun! This interactive cartoon encourages children to join in and exercise alongside these incredibly cute characters, who can at times be a little competitive, too. In doing so, not only will your child have lots of fun, but they will be exercising and developing basic coordination skills along the way. They will also increase muscle strength and sense of balance, which will benefit them in their everyday lives, and keep them healthy and happy.

programme.title: Margo & Felix
programme.desc: Margo and Felix live in a beautiful little house which they must take care of themselves. Although they are responsible for the maintenance of the house they also make lots of time to play games and have fun. Taking on the activities of both adults and children helps to start communication between children and parents about responsibility. Margo and Felix encourages creative thinking and lots of fun.

programme.desc: Two happy rabbits, Sari and Nati have lots of fun playing in Happy Meadow, in this children's cartoon. They have plenty of other lovable friends who also live in Happy Meadow with them. This is a Duck TV production. Duck TV aim to produce content for young children that is educating, and aids their development, while being entertaining at the same time. This show helps children to grow their vocabulary, as they are encouraged to name all of the different animals that they might see playing in the meadow. They also are encouraged to imitate the animal sounds, growing their knowledge even further. The show encourages object recognition, and colour identification, too. All of which is achieved in a fun and creative way.

programme.title: Toby McFly
programme.desc: Toby McFly is a pilot dog, who shows us how the world looks from above. He is flying above beautiful nature scenery, animals, people and different places of interest. After admiring the view from above he lands his plane and shows us in detail what he saw from above.

programme.title: Dotty, the Kitty
programme.desc: A super fun and creative show, Dotty the Kitty attempts to connect the dots that the pencil draws to discover the hidden image and paint the final picture. As always with Duck TV this show make education and development exciting and enjoyable for its young viewers. Helping children to connect the dots improves their ability to recognise and identify shapes and objects, develop hand-eye coordination and for the slightly older viewers it improves their association of objects with their realistic shapes and colours. Encouraging the creativity and imagination out of your child, Dotty the Kitty provides endless fun.

programme.title: Groups
programme.desc: Learning to categorise objects is so much easier with the help of the friendly baby fox in Groups. This show is most beneficial with sufficient interaction with the children that it's aimed at, for example the learning of older children is enhanced by asking them questions such as "what's different" between two or more objects. For younger children it is more beneficial to just point out these differences or similarities. Groups helps to develop young viewers' observational skills, attributing objects into different categories and recognising defining attributes of different objects.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: This cartoon takes a look into the lives of a range of the cutest baby animals, and explores their family relationships. Everyday, after a big adventure exploring their surroundings, they'll return home to their loving families, to be greeted with lots of love and affection. As is the case with many Duck TV programmes, this programme is designed to both educate and entertain it's young audience. Children will become able to recognise the similar characteristic features of animals, develop social skills, and present emotional bonds, as well as thoroughly enjoying their viewing time.

programme.title: Pixie 2
programme.desc: Join Lilali, the happy little purple-haired wizard elf, in his magical world. Lilai just loves to perform his magic tricks. This programme, for very young viewers, can help little ones learn basic vocabulary. Watch with children and repeat the words of the objects on the screen to teach them short, simple words. This short animation has been designed to help promote sound and object recognition and boost a child's cognitive skills. After you have watched the programme you can repeat the vocabulary from the programme whilst playing to reinforce the words learnt.

Incorporating education into enjoyable animations, cartoons and mini-series', Doll Team to the Rescue educates toddlers and children in developing their social skills with others, the importance of friendship, all whilst being able to experience various adventures! The main message within Doll Team to the Rescue is to teach children the love and respect for animals. Ducktv recommend that parents, in order to teach the importance of taking care of people as well as respecting animals, should take them to an animal shelter and explain the necessity of protecting and rescuing animals. Ducktv which specialises in television for absolute beginners create animations, cartoons and miniseries bring fun alongside entertainment for the smallest TV viewers. Under supervision of child psychologists in order to meet all requirements for babies after 3 months, the characteristics of each episode of their shows with music help children to develop their cognitive capabilities. Available 24 hours and 7 days a week, Ducktv ensures to amuse, develop and relax younger audiences as well as educating them in an enjoyable way.

programme.title: Cubie
programme.desc: Animated children's series following Cubie the builder who has fantastic plans for new buildings. Cubie loves to build and, with help from his friends, the cheerful cubes, erects inventive new constructions. With Cubie at the helm, the cubes know exactly what to do, and if they encounter a problem, Cubie is always there to help. This enjoyable series from Duck TV helps children build their spatial awareness and observational skills while learning about new prepositions and the basics of building.

programme.title: Dotty, the Kitty
programme.desc: A super fun and creative show, Dotty the Kitty attempts to connect the dots that the pencil draws to discover the hidden image and paint the final picture. As always with Duck TV this show make education and development exciting and enjoyable for its young viewers. Helping children to connect the dots improves their ability to recognise and identify shapes and objects, develop hand-eye coordination and for the slightly older viewers it improves their association of objects with their realistic shapes and colours. Encouraging the creativity and imagination out of your child, Dotty the Kitty provides endless fun.

programme.title: Small – But Hardworking
programme.desc: This cartoon is designed to entertain and educate very young children, by showing three elves building a variety of different objects with materials such as wood and ice. Duck TV aims to produce content that is educational and aid the development of young children. This show effectively advances children's ability to use their imagination, by stimulating their senses with a bright colourful cartoon, and the moving objects only enhances this further. The programme also aids children in beginning to recognise shapes, preparing them for school in doing so.

programme.title: Groups
programme.desc: Learning to categorise objects is so much easier with the help of the friendly baby fox in Groups. This show is most beneficial with sufficient interaction with the children that it's aimed at, for example the learning of older children is enhanced by asking them questions such as "what's different" between two or more objects. For younger children it is more beneficial to just point out these differences or similarities. Groups helps to develop young viewers' observational skills, attributing objects into different categories and recognising defining attributes of different objects.

programme.title: Didy Baby
programme.desc: Didy Baby is a collection of fun and touching stories all about a group of adorable baby animals. The main theme of this heartwarming yet educational show is the idea of helping each other and working together. It aims to improve its young viewers social skills, develop their observational and thinking skills whilst introducing them to the concept of problem solving and decision making. The show consists of lots of simple situations and stories that encourage creative thinking and widen children's awareness. As an added bonus, problem solving and story telling with your child will help to tighten your relationship.

programme.title: Zack & Ziggy
programme.desc: This lovely animated children's series explores the basic concepts of size and comparison. It follows the everyday adventures of a little nerdy boy named Zack and his loyal dog best friend, Ziggy. The inseparable pair turn every situation into a chance to learn, including taking a walk, playing sports and getting ready for bed. Join the two sweet friends on their exciting exploration of the world around them.

programme.title: Sunville – Sportsville
programme.desc: All of your favourite Sunville residents join together to participate in one amazing sports day. Mister Goat, the Raccoon Family, Kitty Cat and the Friendly Pig are participating in Sports Day, and they want you to come along and join the fun! This interactive cartoon encourages children to join in and exercise alongside these incredibly cute characters, who can at times be a little competitive, too. In doing so, not only will your child have lots of fun, but they will be exercising and developing basic coordination skills along the way. They will also increase muscle strength and sense of balance, which will benefit them in their everyday lives, and keep them healthy and happy.

programme.title: Lola and the Numbers
programme.desc: Lola is a playful little girls who loves numbers! She is constantly on the move and is always ready to count together with her number firends from one to ten. Lola and the Numbers is all about setting that pre-math knowledge for its young viewers. The show helps us to identify different numbers, count from one to ten and develop our pre-math skills. The most important viewing tip is that we always count with Lola! whether in English or your own language, counting along is always fun.

programme.title: Sounds Around Us
programme.desc: Liza and Ben the little elf twins love learning about new sounds. Join them in this series of animated shorts to learn more about sounds, how to find them and how to recreate them. Follow them as they whizz away on exciting adventures together to investigate where different familiar sounds are coming from. Play along with the twins and encourage your child to listen and identify the sounds you hear together. See if you and your child can work out where the sound is coming from before the twins do, while having fun recreating the sounds for yourself at home.

programme.title: Ducky Adventures
programme.desc: Every day is a different adventure for Ducky! This animated show for very young children lets toddlers and pre-schoolers to join Ducky and learn through daily activities. This series is brought to you by DuckTV, which works with child psychologists in creating programmes for babies and toddlers. Ducky Adventures has been designed to help your child develop their observational skills whilst also letting them use their imagination and creativity. This cartoon can be used as a conversation starter for the little ones in your life: you can talk to toddlers about their thoughts and opinions on the activities you've seen in the programme or the things that happen in your toddler's life.

programme.desc: Welcome to the Ristorante, come in and find out all about how the restaurant works. programme.title: World of Toys
programme.desc: Enter a world of games and experience with us fantastic adventures or exercise your fingers and conjure up some exquisite art jewellery. No manuals are needed to do this. Create your own special story and discover new possibilities how to spend a moment together.

programme.title: Happy Meadow
programme.desc: Two happy rabbits, Sari and Nati have lots of fun playing in Happy Meadow, in this children's cartoon. They have plenty of other lovable friends who also live in Happy Meadow with them. This is a Duck TV production. Duck TV aim to produce content for young children that is educating, and aids their development, while being entertaining at the same time. This show helps children to grow their vocabulary, as they are encouraged to name all of the different animals that they might see playing in the meadow. They also are encouraged to imitate the animal sounds, growing their knowledge even further. The show encourages object recognition, and colour identification, too. Get creative and host an animal toy party whilst you watch, or mess around and imitate the animal noises. No matter how you decide to interact with this wonderful show, the Happy Kingdom will always be full of fun.

programme.title: The Way We Travel
programme.desc: This cartoon is designed to aid the development of young children. Your child will watch various vehicles, therefore making them aware of a variety of different shapes and objects in the real world. They will also observe how they operate, which will allow them to grow an understanding of how they may be used in everyday life, as they see their different parts. Additionally, your child will experience the noises that these vehicles make, and be given the opportunity to acquire basic language skills, too. This show will not only keep young children entertained, but it will educate them too, in regards to the outside world.

programme.title: Planet Jumpers
programme.desc: Planet Jumpers is a series set in the future, in space. Through the everyday life of the siblings Luna and Lou we get to know different planets, funky futuristic objects and places while developing the socialization skills of our preschooler viewers.

programme.title: Pixie 2
programme.desc: Join Lilali, the happy little purple-haired wizard elf, in his magical world. Lilai just loves to perform his magic tricks. This programme, for very young viewers, can help little ones learn basic vocabulary. Watch with children and repeat the words of the objects on the screen to teach them short, simple words. This short animation has been designed to help promote sound and object recognition and boost a child's cognitive skills. After you have watched the programme you can repeat the vocabulary from the programme whilst playing to reinforce the words learnt.

programme.title: In the Museum
programme.desc: Can you help Mr.Clown find the missing animals? When animals start mysteriously disappearing from some of the paintings in the museum, Mr.Clown must go searching for them so that he can put them back in their correct places. In the Museum is a great introduction to different kinds of art for the littlest viewers, promotes shape recognition and helps young viewers to recognise and identify different types of animals. Importantly you can also use the animals disappearing as a great way to let young viewers know that it is perfectly okay to make mistakes.

programme.title: Policajná akadémia 5 - Nasadenie: Miami Beach
programme.desc: Kapitán Harris chce být velitelem policejní akademie. Narodil se kvůli tomu. Ovšem velitel Lassard nemíní svoji židli opustit, i když svým podřízeným připravuje stále více starostí. Čeká ho dokonce vyznamenání - v Miami Beach má být vyhlášen policistou desetiletí. Na cestu se vydávají i všichni Lassardovi muži, protože si umí představit, jak by to vypadalo, kdyby se kapitán Harris stal velitelem jejich školy. Na cestu se vydávají i zloději diamantů, aby se seznámili s Lassardovou rybičkou v... akváriu. Na cestu se vydává i kapitán Harris, aby potvrdil, že většího blba mezi policisty nenajdete. Vtipálek Mahoney sice starou partu z akademie opustil, mnozí další však zůstali, a tak se můžete znovu setkat s mohutným černochem Mosesem Hightowerem, háklivým na každou narážku týkající se barvy kůže, lehce trhlým imitátorem zvuků Larvellem Jonesem, drobnou a nesmělou černoškou Laverne Hooksovou, která dokáže svůj tichounký dětský hlásek nahradit v případě potřeby hurónským řevem. Nechybí samozřejmě ani fanatický pistolník Tackleberry, energická Debie Callahan, roztržitý velitel Lassard a... na druhé straně ambiciózní blb kapitán Harris se svým vlezlým poskokem Proctorem. Všichni se tentokr át vydávají na prázdniny do Miami Beach, kde se koná kongres policejních náčelníků. Zatímco Lassard tu má před svým odchodem do důchodu být vyhlášen policistou století, Harris se chce postarat, aby byl místo něj zvolen velitelem policejní akademie. Ostatní chtějí svého velitele podpořit, znemožní Harrise, Lassardovi zajistí další službu v čele akademie a ještě přitom stihnou dopadnout bandu zlodějů diamantů.

programme.title: Na telo
programme.desc: Moderátorka Karolína Lacová a slovenskí politici v atraktívnej diskusii. Moderátorka Karolína Lacová privíta každú nedeľu atraktívnych hostí z radov politikov v diskusii na aktuálne témy, ktoré hýbu Slovenskom.\nHostia: Rudolf Huliak: minister cestovného ruchu a športu (Strana vidieka, nom. Smer-SD) a Igor Matovič: poslanec NR SR, predseda hnutia Slovensko.

programme.title: Osobný strážca
programme.desc: Frank Farmer má rád věci pod kontrolou. Konečně, jako bývalý agent tajné služby chránil dva prezidenty a mnoho dalších významných osob. Jeho povolání profesionálního osobního strážce jej nutí mít přehled o každém detailu své činnosti. Nesmí dát protivníkovi žádnou šanci. Své úkoly plní přesně a bez problémů. Až do chvíle, kdy se setkává s Rachel Marronovou. Rachel je superhvězda populární hudby a její kariéra neustále stoupá. S popularitou přicházejí věci obvyklé - manažer, novináři, spousta... nových známých - i věci méně zvyklé, jichž se bojí každý slavný člověk - nevyzpytatelní fanouškové. Od jednoho z nich začíná Rachel dostávat bláznivé dopisy s poněkud nebezpečným podtónem. Musí se postarat o svou bezpečnost. Rachel chce osobního strážce - a nejlepší je Frank Farmer. Tak se setkají dva špičkoví profesionálové. Oba očekávají, že budou vůdčí osobností tohoto vztahu. Neočekávají, že se do sebe zamilují.. Špičkový osobní strážce Frank Farmer se nechá přemluvit, aby přijal místo u populární černošské zpěvačky a herečky Rachel Marronové, která dostala několik výhružných dopisů a jen náhodou unikla atentátu. Přestože hvězda o nového osobního strážce nestojí (manažeři před ní tají nejen výhružné dopisy, ale také důvod atentátu), Frank nakonec práci na naléhání černocha Devaneye přijme. Seznamuje se s neobvyklým prostředím hudebního průmyslu, s nímž dosud neměl žádné zkušenosti, a přes... své profesionální zásady se zaplete do milostného vztahu se svůdnou zpěvačkou. Pomalu vychází najevo, že výhrůžné dopisy nemají s útokem nic společného a že útočníkem není psychopatický fanoušek, jak se zpočátku zdálo, ale zkušený profesionál, který dostal za vraždu dobře zaplaceno. Frank tuší, že rozhodující útok přijde během slavnostního předávání Oscara, na kterého byla Rachel nominována za nejlepší herecký výkon. Po jeho předchozích opatřeních se však psychicky vyčerpaná zpěvačka rozhodne ochranu těsně před kritickým okamžikem odmítnout. Frank je však i přesto ve střehu, připraven obětovat pro Rachel život.

programme.title: Farma XVIII.
programme.desc:
DUEL Reality šou, SR (2026). Moderuje Marek Fašiang. Najdlhšie vysielaná a najúspešnejšia slovenská reality šou otvára novú kapitolu. Televízia Markíza prináša už 18. sériu Farmy, ktorá divákov po prvý raz zavedie do sveta vinohradníctva a vinárstva. Dejiskom veľkolepého farmárskeho dobrodružstva sa stanú Malé Karpaty – región s bohatou vinohradníckou tradíciou, kde štrnásť súťažiacich čaká nielen boj o výhru až do výšky 100 000 eur, ale aj náročná cesta za záchranou starého vinohradu a výrobou vlastného vína.
Tentoraz sa Farma presunie na... opustenú vinársku usadlosť v srdci Malých Karpát, kde sa farmári budú musieť naučiť remeslu, ktoré je neoddeliteľnou súčasťou slovenských tradícií. Ich úlohou nebude iba zvládnuť náročné podmienky a uspieť v hre, ale predovšetkým vdýchnuť nový život zanedbanému vinohradu. Počas celej série si osvoja vinárske postupy a na jej konci predstavia vlastné farmárske víno – výsledok mesiacov tvrdej práce, spolupráce aj odhodlania.
Ústredným motívom novej série bude pravda. Podtitul „Vo víne je pravda“ nebude iba odkazom na vinársku tematiku, ale stane sa jedným z kľúčových pilierov celej hry. Farmári budú opakovane čeliť situáciám, ktoré preveria ich úprimnosť, charakter, lojalitu aj odvahu postaviť sa pravde tvárou v tvár.
Osemnásta séria prinesie aj výrazné herné novinky. Farmári budú od začiatku rozdelení do dvoch skupín, pričom jedna získa výrazne lepšie podmienky na život a prácu, zatiaľ čo druhá bude musieť zvládať nielen náročné úlohy, ale aj podstatne skromnejšie zázemie. Samotné prostredie sa tak stane ďalšou skúškou ich odolnosti, vytrvalosti a schopnosti fungovať pod tlakom. Priebeh hry ovplyvnia aj nové mechanizmy, nečakané zvraty a strategické rozhodnutia, ktoré môžu zásadne zmeniť rozloženie síl aj podobu duelov.
Sprievodcom novej série zostáva obľúbený herec a moderátor Marek Fašiang, na dodržiavanie farmárskeho poriadku bude opäť dohliadať skúsený hospodár Martin Bagar. Súčasťou Farmy zostáva aj umelá inteligencia Alica, ktorá bude aj v 18. sérii zohrávať dôležitú úlohu.
Historicky prvýkrát zároveň dostane hospodár po svojom boku odborného garanta. Stane sa ním uznávaný vinár Tomáš Dudo, ktorý pochádza z vinárskej rodiny s viac ako 400-ročnou tradíciou. Počas celej série bude farmárov sprevádzať pri plnení vinárskych úloh, odovzdávať im svoje skúsenosti a dohliadať na to, aby zvládli jednotlivé postupy čo najlepšie.

programme.title: Love Island VI.
programme.desc: Najhorúcejšia romantická reality šou. Moderuje Zorka Hejdová. Najhorúcejšia reality šou Love Island Česko & Slovensko je späť. Šiesta séria plná pokušení prinesie veľké zmeny – divákov čaká nová destinácia, moderná luxusná vila a súboje o lásku plné vášne, humoru aj sĺz. Kto obstojí v náročných skúškach, kto podľahne pokušeniu a kto sa vráti domov so zlomeným srdcom? Dianím vo vile bude aj tentoraz sprevádzať očarujúca Zorka Hejdová. Diváci môžu prostredníctvom aplikácie Love Island ovplyvňovať kľúčové momenty šou a nakoniec aj rozhodnúť o víťaznom... páre. Na konci tejto vzrušujúcej cesty však nie je v hre len srdce vysnívanej polovičky, ale aj rozpráv ková výhra 75 000 eur.

programme.title: Ako ukradnúť nevestu
programme.desc: Ženami obletovaný Tom si konečně uvědomil, že miluje svou nejlepší kamarádku. Ta se ovšem právě zasnoubila s bohatým a pohledným Skotem a plánuje se k němu přestěhovat. Zamilovaný kamarád se ale jen tak nevzdává a vyráží do Skotska s jasným cílem, ukrást srdce nevěsty.. Tom si užívá života. Je sexy, úspěšný a ví, že se může kdykoliv spolehnout na Hannah, svou okouzlující nejlepší kamarádku, která je jediným neměnným prvkem v jeho životě. Vezme ji na šestou svatbu svého otce, kde ovšem pozná dívku, která má více v hrudníku než v hlavě. Hannah Tomovi oznámí, že odjíždí na šest týdnů pracovně do Skotska, a mladík si s úžasem uvědomí, jak je jeho život bez ní prázdný. Rozhodne se, že jakmile se vrátí, požádá ji o ruku. Je ale ohromen, když se dozví, že se... zasnoubila s bohatým a pohledným Skotem a plánuje se k němu přestěhovat. Hannah ho požádá, aby šel na sva tbu za družičku, takže jsou všichni Colinovi příbuzní přesvědčeni, že je gay. Během předsvatebního večírku se Tom a Hannah konečně poprvé políbí. Mladík svou kamarádku prosí, aby se nevdávala. V den svatby chce odjet domů, pak si ale uvědomí, že nesmí promarnit svou poslední příležitost. Vtrhne do kostela, aby sňatku zabránil.

programme.title: Susedské prípady
programme.desc: Nočný fantóm Viete, vedľa koho vlastne žijete. Nočný fantóm: Dôchodkyňa Pavlína žije v malej štvorbytovke. Pavlínina priateľka Gerda, ktorá prichádza na návštevu, sa rozhodne vypátrať, čo je za tým..

programme.title: Rodinné prípady
programme.desc: Rodiny sú rôzne a aj život v nich prebieha rôznym spôsobom. Aj pri najlepšej snahe sa rodičom výchova detí občas vymkne z rúk a hotové nešťastie je na svete. Inokedy stačí, že sa začlenia do nesprávnej partie a celá rodina má zrazu zo života peklo! Presne takýmito situáciami sa zaoberá nový formát s názvom Rodinné prípady (skryté titulky).

programme.title: Farma XVIII.
programme.desc: Na obrazovky televízie Markíza mieri desiata séria reality šou Farma. Nová Farma predstavuje kompletný reštart a šancu na úplne nový život. Budeme svedkami totálneho úniku zo súčasného sveta plného chaosu a zmätku a zároveň druhej životnej šance, ktorá prináša radikálnu zmenu spôsobu života, budovania vzťahov a spôsobu myslenia. Súťažiaci si budú mať možnosť vybudovať od základov novú Farmu v úplne novom prostredí, aké sa doteraz v reality šou nevyskytlo.

programme.title: Farma XVIII.
programme.desc:
DUEL Reality šou, SR (2026). Moderuje Marek Fašiang. Najdlhšie vysielaná a najúspešnejšia slovenská reality šou otvára novú kapitolu. Televízia Markíza prináša už 18. sériu Farmy, ktorá divákov po prvý raz zavedie do sveta vinohradníctva a vinárstva. Dejiskom veľkolepého farmárskeho dobrodružstva sa stanú Malé Karpaty – región s bohatou vinohradníckou tradíciou, kde štrnásť súťažiacich čaká nielen boj o výhru až do výšky 100 000 eur, ale aj náročná cesta za záchranou starého vinohradu a výrobou vlastného vína.
Tentoraz sa Farma presunie na... opustenú vinársku usadlosť v srdci Malých Karpát, kde sa farmári budú musieť naučiť remeslu, ktoré je neoddeliteľnou súčasťou slovenských tradícií. Ich úlohou nebude iba zvládnuť náročné podmienky a uspieť v hre, ale predovšetkým vdýchnuť nový život zanedbanému vinohradu. Počas celej série si osvoja vinárske postupy a na jej konci predstavia vlastné farmárske víno – výsledok mesiacov tvrdej práce, spolupráce aj odhodlania.
Ústredným motívom novej série bude pravda. Podtitul „Vo víne je pravda“ nebude iba odkazom na vinársku tematiku, ale stane sa jedným z kľúčových pilierov celej hry. Farmári budú opakovane čeliť situáciám, ktoré preveria ich úprimnosť, charakter, lojalitu aj odvahu postaviť sa pravde tvárou v tvár.
Osemnásta séria prinesie aj výrazné herné novinky. Farmári budú od začiatku rozdelení do dvoch skupín, pričom jedna získa výrazne lepšie podmienky na život a prácu, zatiaľ čo druhá bude musieť zvládať nielen náročné úlohy, ale aj podstatne skromnejšie zázemie. Samotné prostredie sa tak stane ďalšou skúškou ich odolnosti, vytrvalosti a schopnosti fungovať pod tlakom. Priebeh hry ovplyvnia aj nové mechanizmy, nečakané zvraty a strategické rozhodnutia, ktoré môžu zásadne zmeniť rozloženie síl aj podobu duelov.
Sprievodcom novej série zostáva obľúbený herec a moderátor Marek Fašiang, na dodržiavanie farmárskeho poriadku bude opäť dohliadať skúsený hospodár Martin Bagar. Súčasťou Farmy zostáva aj umelá inteligencia Alica, ktorá bude aj v 18. sérii zohrávať dôležitú úlohu.
Historicky prvýkrát zároveň dostane hospodár po svojom boku odborného garanta. Stane sa ním uznávaný vinár Tomáš Dudo, ktorý pochádza z vinárskej rodiny s viac ako 400-ročnou tradíciou. Počas celej série bude farmárov sprevádzať pri plnení vinárskych úloh, odovzdávať im svoje skúsenosti a dohliadať na to, aby zvládli jednotlivé postupy čo najlepšie.

programme.title: Hriech
programme.desc: Luciin prípad preberá vyšetrovateľka, ktorá má na rozdiel od Ondreja jediný cieľ - čo najskôr prípad uzavrieť. Lucia je čoraz viac prenasledovaná fragmentami spomienok, ktoré však nedokáže poskladať do zmysluplného celku. Ondrej sa odmieta vzdať a podarí sa mu nájsť stopu, vedúcu k privátnemu poľovníckemu klubu pre miestnu smotánku. Jeho vzťah s manželkou Norou sa však ocitá v troskách. Ondrejovi ostáva iba niekoľko dní, kedy môže rozpliesť Luciin prípad - inak ju odsúdia na dlhoročný trest.

programme.title: Simpsonovi
programme.sub-title: Little Girl in the Big Ten
programme.desc: Líza konečně najde kamarádky na své intelektuální úrovni - jenže Carrie a Tina jsou vysokoškolačky, a tak Líza předstírá, že je mnohem starší. Bart má také problém s izolovaností - jenomže nedobrovolnou. Byl nakažen virem Panda a je dočasně nucen pobývat v plastové bublině. Nebyl by to ovšem Bart, kdyby tento handicap nedokázal bohatě využít.

programme.title: Simpsonovi
programme.desc: Homer má pro Marge překvapení k výročí svatby: zahradní jezírko. Jezírko skrývá překvapení: ohrožený druh housenky zvané řvousenka. Děj epizody se dál překvapivě vyvíjí a nakonec přivádí manžele Simpsonovy do vězení. Jsou obžalováni ze zločinu nejtěžšího.

programme.title: Grand Tour V
programme.desc: (The Grand Tour V) Jeremy, Richard a James majú v pláne prejsť východnú Európu od severu na juh. Z poľského Gdansku až k slovinskému jazeru Bled. A to v autách, v ktorých by nikdy nikto na podobnú cestu nevyrazil... Britsko-americká šou (2023). Moderujú J. Clarkson, R. Hammond a J. May. Program je opatrený skrytými titulkami (ST).

programme.title: Simpsonovi
programme.sub-title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
programme.desc: Tetnto díl potěší především příznivce rocku a zejména skupiny Rolling Stones. V druhé epizodě nové řady totiž tato kapela pořádá pro své příznivce letní tábory, mezi nimiž se ocitne i blažený Homer Simpson. Jak je v originální verzi seriálu zvykem, kresleným muzikantům skutečně propůjčili své hlasy živé rockové legendy.

programme.title: Simpsonovi
programme.sub-title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
programme.desc: Na základě výsledků ročníkových testů je Líza přeřazena do vyšší, třetí třídy - kam se současně díky propastně nízkým hodnotám svých testů naopak propadá Bart. Z takové situace samozřejmě není ani jeden z nich nadšený. Když ještě na třídním výletu do Washingtonu musejí vytvořit dvojici, sourozenecká averze narůstá.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy tests the Nissan Cube, one of the most popular cars in Japan. Richard tests the new Cadillac CTS. James tests the Jaguar XJS which is being updated and modernized (the original XJS was poorly built). Richard investigates whether you could run your car on poop (In detail: Running on LPG from biomass from humans or animals). Jeremy reviews the Renault Clio 182 on the test track.

programme.title: Piánko
programme.desc: Najviac zaľúbených pesničiek a príjemných romantických hitov na jednom mieste. Uvoľnite sa, relaxujte a ak máte niekoho pri sebe, tak mu povedzte, ako ho ľúbite... Tento čas je ideálny pre romantické vyznanie lásky, alebo pre Váš relax.

programme.title: Galavečer hviezd
programme.desc: Hudobno-zábavný program s hviezdami Televízie SENZI a moderátorom Jánom Žitňanským. www.senzi.sk.

programme.desc: Televízia SENZI a jej osobnosti sú Vám na dosah aj pri živých koncertoch vo vybraných mestách. Pozrite sa, ako Vás bavia tí najlepší zabávači, humoristi, speváci a hudobné skupiny. A to všetko pod taktovkou Otta Weitera.
